children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on November 27 with investors reacting to brokerage recommendations and regulatory developments.

Share price of Zydus Lifesciences fell more than 1 percent after its US subsidiary, Zydus Therapeutics Inc., received a Complete Response Letter (CRL) from the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for its New Drug Application (NDA) for Saroglitazar. The letter relates to the company's resolution plan addressing observations raised during the October 2026 inspection of its Moraiya facility.
Shares of Syrma SGS and Avalon Technologies rose nearly 2% each after JPMorgan upgraded the stocks to 'neutral'.

Lemon Tree Hotels share price rose nearly 1 percent after company announced the opening of Keys Select by Lemon Tree Hotels in Pali. With this addition, the group's operational portfolio in Maharashtra has expanded to 17 hotels, while another 15 properties are in the development pipeline. The property operates under a franchise agreement, further strengthening the group's presence and expanding its development pipeline across the region.
On the sectoral front, Nifty PSU Bank and Metal indices rose more than 1 percent each, while IT index shed 1.6%.
Broader markets traded higher, with the Nifty Midcap and Smallcap indices gaining nearly 1 percent each.
Market breadth remained positive on the BSE, with 2314 shares advancing against 995 declining, while 196 stocks remained unchanged.

title: Price Action: Zydus Lifesciences slips on USFDA CRL; Syrma SGS, Avalon Technologies gain after JPMorgan upgrades
